item.description:
### A clearer block list editor
Creating a list used to mean scrolling one long column, with the category chips wrapping over five rows and Save waiting below the fold. The editor is now two columns: the list's name, its Blocklist/Exceptions switch and its apps on the left, the websites — domain field, categories, and everything you have picked — on the right, with a line at the bottom telling you exactly what the list will block once it is active. Nothing is hidden below the fold any more, and it reads the same in light and dark mode.
### Setup asks for Accessibility once, and waits with you
Kahf Guard needs macOS Accessibility to block apps and websites. Onboarding now holds at that step until the permission is actually granted, with a small floating guide showing where the switch lives in System Settings, and moves on by itself the moment you flip it — instead of letting you walk past it and finding nothing blocked later.
### Sheets no longer darken the whole window
Opening a block or session sheet used to turn the entire app dark, and closing it left the window chrome light with dark content inside. Sheets now keep their own appearance to themselves, over a softer blurred backdrop.
